run_django_manage: run the Django manage.py entry point to execute administrative tasks via command line
run_django_server: run the Django development server using manage.py with the runserver command
run_django_migrate: run database migrations using the Django manage.py migrate command
run_django_shell: run an interactive Django shell using manage.py to inspect models and data
run_django_createsuperuser: run manage.py to create a Django superuser for the admin interface
